fields.summary_ko.0: AMD's Q3 2026 revenue is estimated at $13 billion (±$300 million), representing 41% YoY growth and likely to align with consensus estimates of $13.22 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center segment growth is driven by increased demand for EPYC server processors and Instinct MI350 GPUs, while client business is supported by expanded adoption of Ryzen AI PRO 400 series.
fields.summary_ko.2: Competitive strength is enhanced with the launch of 6th-generation EPYC Venice processors and Helios AI platform, with limited Q3 contribution but establishing a foundation for future growth.
